layers.methodology: 100 same-activation paired order crossovers, order sequence alternates; continuous same-stream submissions with no synchronization between order trials and one final synchronization; 4 warmups/order; 3 captured real activations; identical per-call NPU events; exact original ND BF16 Linear weights and HF gate->SiLU semantics.

100 same-activation paired order crossovers, order sequence alternates; continuous same-stream submissions with no synchronization between order trials and one final synchronization; 4 warmups/order; 3 captured real activations; identical per-call NPU events; exact original ND BF16 Linear weights and HF gate->SiLU semantics.

limitations: Standalone pair and local complete MLP wrapper, not full model decode.
Event time includes stream scheduling/queue effects; it is not isolated Cube execution time.
Gate/up calls use distinct real weights. Crossing their order separates weight identity from position; it does not prove why a weight-specific difference occurs.
No full Decode or end-to-end change is enabled in this experiment.
